crop_policy.association: Each torso must have >=90% of its area within exactly one whole-animal prediction, and that whole prediction must have exactly one such torso. Otherwise abstain. Assign whole-animal trackID to torso evidence. Never associate via identity label or query truth.
crop_policy.geometry: Apply existing min64px, no-border, overlap<=.2 eligibility to torso rectangles; whole box may touch image boundary. Track/display/IoU metric retain original whole-visible-animal rectangle.
crop_policy.model: Unadapted official MIEWid FP32, existing input transform; no new embedding training

adaptation.source: June8-only two-class whole-visible-animal and visible-coat-torso boxes

amendment: June8-only engineering cadence control after baseline found only3/7 clean enrollment references. Same detector/640/.25/1280 and same3 agreement/.65 similarity/.1margin/.2overlap. No query pixels or model outputs used for choice.

enrollment.frames: All June8 known clips at5fps; max10 confirmed clean predicted crops per cow
enrollment.selection: First-day predicted crops only. Human-confirm principal-cow identity and clean visibility without query images. Medoid then farthest-point diversity using official rawMIEW cosine, deterministic frame-index ties; keep fewer if fewer eligible confirmed crops. Count all proposed/rejected/corrected crops. No unknown photos enrolled.

gates.limitations: Only7known and2unknown return passages; even zero observed errors cannot certify these rates

identity_policy.query_cache: Content and encoder fingerprints; no expected IDs in keys
identity_policy.state: Fresh tracker and temporal identity state per clip; same immutable confirmed gallery; finish async preparation before scored frames and report startup cost separately

metrics.offline_three_crop_aggregate: Optional separately labeled diagnostic only; cannot substitute production-policy result
metrics.primary: Full-clip1fps one-to-oneIoU>=.5 conservative named precision; correct names / all visible enrolled-cow annotations including missed/rejected crops; unknown false names / all visible unenrolled cows; unmatched named boxes are errors
secondary: One decision per physical passage; retain all earlier wrong-name durations
Latency to correct name, naming gaps, track/identity switches
Enrollment effort, startup latency, pipeline time and memory

predeclared_alternate_if_enrollment_inco.rule: Only if preset5fps still cannot enroll every known cow, repeat all June8 known clips with this already-trained cow detector at exactly the same confidence/imgsz/cadence. No new training or query inference.

purpose: Small controlled-view later-day feasibility complement; does not replace crowded-scene goal or establish farm reliability
query_truth_requirement: Existing independent105-frame annotations are unchanged and must be bound in the final query freeze.
selection: Fixed first-day-only adaptation. June9 is exposed regression; no claim of new blind testing or post-query tuning.
source_sampling: Sequential decode source clips; process0,6,12,... at5fps. Query accuracy scored only on independently annotated frozen1fps frames, with all preceding5fps observations updating actual state.
